name: Roberto Bonomi
features: olive skin, dark hair greying at the temples, dark eyes, broad face, heavy brows, solid build, genial assured expression
bio: An Argentine landowner and local politician who raced as a gentleman entrant and was national sports car champion in 1952 and 1953, going to Europe with the Argentine national team. He started one Formula One World Championship Grand Prix, his home race at Buenos Aires in 1960, for Scuderia Centro Sud.
